I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

I found nothing to check it against. The shared files have no Brackenwater account folder, contract or CRM record, and nobody has mentioned Brackenwater in #central-team before. My reply records the date as unverified. It also says not to put it on the calendar or in a forecast until the account owner has checked it against the signed contract or got it in writing from the customer. I offered to set up a renewal reminder once it's confirmed.

A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed. I didn't change anything else.
